zh.title: 阿聯酋航空將以空中巴士A380執飛雅加達包機
zh.summary: 阿聯酋航空預計於下週末派遣空中巴士A380客機執飛前往雅加達的罕見航班。根據Simple Flying報導，這項包機服務專門用於運送特定的歐洲足球俱樂部團隊。此外，阿聯酋航空目前正推動涵蓋219架空中巴士A380與波音777客機的改裝計畫。
body: 根據Simple Flying報導，阿聯酋航空預計於下週末調派空中巴士A380客機，執飛前往印尼雅加達的罕見航班。該項包機服務專門用於運送特定歐洲足球俱樂部團隊前往當地。
在機隊營運與維護背景方面，阿聯酋航空工程部門先前推動了數十億美元的機隊翻新計畫，預計全面改裝219架空中巴士A380與波音777客機。
此外，阿聯酋航空工程部門先前亦推出了為期六週的Material Futures Studio計畫，邀請大學生重新利用退役飛機材料並開發新產品。

en.title: Emirates to Operate Rare Airbus A380 Charter Flight to Jakarta
en.summary: Emirates is scheduled to operate a rare Airbus A380 flight to Jakarta next weekend. According to reports from Simple Flying, the charter service is being deployed specifically to transport a select group of European football clubs to the Indonesian capital. In historical fleet developments, Emirates Engineering has been advancing a multi-billion-dollar retrofit program that encompasses a complete refurbishment of 219 Airbus A380 and Boeing 777 aircraft to modernize passenger cabin interiors across its widebody operational fleet.
body: According to a report by Simple Flying, Emirates is scheduled to operate a rare Airbus A380 flight to Jakarta next weekend. The charter service is being deployed specifically to transport a select group of European football clubs to Indonesia.

In historical fleet developments, Emirates Engineering has been advancing a multi-billion-dollar retrofit program to fully refurbish 219 Airbus A380 and Boeing 777 aircraft aimed at upgrading cabin experiences across its widebody fleet.

Additionally, Emirates Engineering launched the Material Futures Studio, a six-week initiative encouraging university students to re-imagine materials from retired aircraft and convert them into new products.
